rationale: The stock gapped up ~15%, reversed the entire premium, and has now pinned to the day's low with five flat, shrinking-volume candles (ATR compressed to $0.02) — a state that resolves in either direction but currently shows no resolution. With only 10 minutes to the close, any entry is effectively an overnight position in an unidentified-catalyst name trading 2.9x normal volume, where going long means catching a knife below both VWAPs and going short means chasing the low of day into a potential late squeeze. With no news, no float/short data, and no edge in a 10-minute window, sitting out is the highest-expectancy action.
